description: This file contains utility functions and classes for the Android Monkey testing framework, including date formatting and package filtering.

classes.name: MonkeyUtils
classes.description: Provides utility functions such as date formatting and package filtering for the Monkey testing framework.

classes.name: PackageFilter
classes.description: A nested static class within MonkeyUtils that manages valid and invalid package sets for filtering purposes.

methods.name: toCalendarTime
methods.description: Converts a timestamp into a formatted calendar time string.

methods.name: getPackageFilter
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the PackageFilter class.

methods.name: addValidPackages
methods.description: Adds a set of package names to the list of valid packages.

methods.name: addInvalidPackages
methods.description: Adds a set of package names to the list of invalid packages.

methods.name: hasValidPackages
methods.description: Checks if there are any valid packages set.

methods.name: isPackageValid
methods.description: Checks if a package is in the valid packages set.

methods.name: isPackageInvalid
methods.description: Checks if a package is in the invalid packages set.

methods.name: checkEnteringPackage
methods.description: Determines whether the given package should be processed based on inclusion/exclusion filters.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the lists of allowed and disallowed packages.
